title: Plasma Brain Natriuretic Peptide Levels in Pregnancy
brief_summary: To evaluate the maternal blood concentrations of brain natriuretic peptide (BNP) during the second and third trimesters of a normal pregnancy. We will attempt to define a normal range for pregnancy and any outliers that may serve as markers for abnormal cardiovascular physiology.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* women age 18 to 40
* second trimester of pregnancy

Exclusion Criteria:

* known cardiac or valvular disease,
* atrial fibrillation or other arrhythmia,
* pulmonary hypertension,
* chronic hypertension,
* hypertensive disorders of pregnancy,
* morbid obesity (BMI \> 40 kg/meter squared)
* history of sleep apnea
* multiple gestation
* known renal dysfunction
* medications known to affect cardiac function
* current or past abnormal echocardiogram
